newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber ends mostly lower on quiet cash market.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber ends mostly lower on quiet cash market.

text.p: CME lumber futures drifted down after an initial rally and ended mostly lower in light dealings, traders said.
Lumber closed $1.70 per tbf lower to $0.80 lower with March off $0.50 at $400.00 and May off $1.70 at $389.00.
Initial scattered buying met little resistance and prices shot up as buy stops were hit. But follow-through buying was lacking and prices turned lower as cash markets remained quiet, traders said.
Saul Stone, Refco, Lind-Waldock and Dean Witter bought early while selling was mixed, sources said.
